objective: Externally evaluate the digital twin's ambient-temperature high-pressure hydrogen release and inventory-depletion physics against PRESLHY E3.1 DisCha experiments.
claim_boundary: This protocol evaluates a rigid source vessel discharging through a nominal circular aperture. It does not validate a vehicle-fueling loop, cryogenic two-phase release, a site vent stack, pipe backpressure, ignition, dispersion, or emergency separation distance.

source.title: PRESLHY Experiment series E3.1 (Cryogenic Hydrogen Blow-down/Discharge) results - part A high pressure
source.prior_information_seen: The public technical report, its summary plots and experiment matrices were inspected. No numerical Excel outcome file from the archive was opened before this protocol was frozen.

include: Excel numerical result files from packages named PRE3P1A_KIT_D*_300K_DATA.zip
measured vessel pressure and a recorded valve-opening synchronization signal
positive initial absolute pressure above ambient
at least 20 pressure samples after valve opening
exclude_without_model_outcome_review: pressure trace increasing after the synchronized release start for more than 10 percent of usable samples
documented sensor saturation or acquisition failure

time_alignment.zero: first valve-relay transition identified by the source synchronized-time channel
time_alignment.evaluation_end: first sample at or below 1.05 times measured ambient absolute pressure, or the last valid recorded sample
time_alignment.prediction_mapping: linear interpolation onto experimental timestamps; no dynamic time warping or time shift optimization

model_definition.initial_pressure: first valid measured vessel absolute pressure before release
model_definition.initial_temperature: median valid internal gas-temperature channels during the final 0.5 s before valve opening; use report nominal 293.15 K only when every internal temperature channel is unavailable and flag the substitution
model_definition.ambient_pressure: measured ambient absolute pressure, otherwise 101325 Pa with a substitution flag
model_definition.outflow: current DynamicLeakModel real-gas isentropic restriction with discharge coefficient 0.8
model_definition.inventory_energy: rigid adiabatic control volume; remove upstream specific enthalpy with discharged mass
model_definition.valve_and_pipe: instantaneous full opening with no explicit upstream line inventory, valve travel or pipe backpressure

final_mass_loss_relative_error_percent.quality_note: The PRESLHY report describes balance-derived mass as qualitative; this endpoint cannot override the pressure endpoints.

aggregate_decision.negative_result_policy: A failed screen remains a publishable model-development result and prohibits a validated blowdown/vent claim.

sensitivity_only_not_calibration.claim_rule: Only the pre-existing 0.8 result controls the primary decision; sensitivity runs cannot replace it or be selected after outcome inspection.
